  "situation": "The ship had received a briefing that the probability of a deliberate attack on U.S. warships was low but that indiscriminate attacks in the Persian Gulf were a significant danger, and that ships were required to inform unknown aircraft of their identity and position. The commander had been briefed earlier that an Iraqi aircraft was operating in the area and instructed the tactical action officer to monitor track 2202. Radar video of an unknown aircraft was obtained and continuously tracked as it closed on the ship. The tactical action officer requested permission to transmit a standard warning, but the lieutenant denied the request. The commander had left the bridge earlier and was not present when the aircraft turned toward the ship. A warning was eventually transmitted, but not in the wording prescribed by the rules of engagement.",
